content.text:
Iridium Communications Inc. Form 8-K regarding definitive proxy and special meeting: The filing states that the special meeting was scheduled for September 24, 2026, beginning at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time, and that the proxy materials sought approval of transaction-related proposals. (time=2026-08-26; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Iridium Stockholders Approve Acquisition by Rocket Lab: The release reports that Iridium stockholders adopted the merger agreement; about 99.6% of votes cast favored it, representing about 81.0% of outstanding shares entitled to vote. It describes consideration as $27 cash plus Rocket Lab shares under an exchange ratio with a collar, with a stated notional value of $54 per Iridium share. (time=2026-09-24T16:30:00-04:00; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Iridium Stockholders Approve Acquisition by Rocket Lab: Rocket Lab's investor-relations page carries the same September 24 announcement, labeled GlobeNewswire, including the vote result and the remaining conditions to closing. (time=2026-09-24T16:30:00-04:00; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
